risk_tiers.name: Low Risk
risk_tiers.description: Strong repayment profile; default probability is low relative to the portfolio.

risk_tiers.name: Moderate Risk
risk_tiers.description: Acceptable repayment profile with some risk factors present.

risk_tiers.name: High Risk
risk_tiers.description: Elevated default probability; multiple risk factors present.

risk_tiers.name: Very High Risk
risk_tiers.description: Default probability is high; approval is not recommended without mitigation.

Route to a credit analyst for manual review before a decision is made.
Decline under standard policy; only proceed via an exception process.
